caption: Sint-Petrusbasiliek, Oirschot
composition: Gothic brick basilica and west tower from the market · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Sint-Petrusbasiliek at Oirschot shows a tall brick west tower and a slender spire above the Gothic nave, from the market. The church is closed. It is overcast, about 11.0°C, with wind near 9.0 km/h and cloud cover about 87%. No shop name is readable. St John's Cathedral is another church and is not in this frame.
